topic_ko: 진정한 사회적 목적 대 목적 세탁
_note: 원문 유형은 문장 삽입. insert 유형을 가장 강하게 출제. 유형마다 passage 를 다르게 paraphrase.

passage: Sensing the rewards of standing out, some brands announce a social purpose before doing much real good.
Their marketers use that purpose to polish the brand's image rather than truly embracing it.
Solving genuine social problems is hard, and it demands an authentic, company-wide commitment.
Without such commitment, the mission is mere window-dressing — what we might call 'purpose-washing.'
It resembles green-washing, where purpose-driven activity exists mainly for publicity.
Such brands gain differentiation, one benefit of social purpose, but only briefly.
They forfeit a strong position in future markets.
They may even make their own employees feel worse about the company.
choices: the difference between authentic social purpose and superficial purpose-washing
why social purpose has no effect on a brand's reputation
how marketers measure the success of advertising campaigns
why employees prefer companies that avoid social causes
how green products came to dominate global markets
theme.explanation_ko: 진정한 전사적 헌신 없는 사회적 목적은 '목적 세탁'에 그쳐 단기 차별화만 얻고 미래 시장 위치를 잃는다는 내용. ①이 주제.
theme.distractor_ko: ②영향 없음, ③광고 성과 측정, ④사회적 명분 회피 선호, ⑤친환경 제품 점유는 초점이 아니다.

passage: We should be wary of brands that broadcast a social purpose before they have done much good.
Too often, marketers use such purpose merely to boost the brand's reputation.
Making a real difference is hard, and it must flow from an authentic, company-wide commitment.
Anything less is just window-dressing, a practice we call purpose-washing.
Like green-washing, it serves publicity rather than genuine change.
We must insist that social purpose be lived, not merely advertised.
Brands that fake it win only a brief moment of differentiation.
In the end, they lose their footing in future markets and dishearten their own staff.
choices: 사회적 목적은 광고가 아니라 전사적 헌신으로 진정하게 실천되어야 한다.
브랜드는 사회적 목적을 가능한 한 빨리 공표해야 한다.
차별화를 위해서는 단기 홍보 전략이 가장 효과적이다.
친환경 활동은 기업 평판에 거의 영향을 주지 않는다.
claim.explanation_ko: 사회적 목적은 홍보가 아니라 진정한 전사적 헌신으로 실천되어야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 목적 세탁에 불과하다는 주장. ①.
claim.distractor_ko: ②빠른 공표, ③단기 홍보 전략, ④친환경 무영향, ⑤직원 무관함은 본문 주장과 다르다.

passage: Some brands trumpet a social purpose long before they create any real benefit.
For their marketers, the purpose is a tool to lift reputation, not a value to live by.
But true social impact requires an authentic commitment across the whole company.
Without that, the mission is only window-dressing — purpose-washing.
It mirrors green-washing, existing chiefly for publicity.
Fake purpose buys a brand a short spell of differentiation.
Yet it costs the brand its place in tomorrow's markets.
It can even leave employees ashamed of where they work.
choices: 사회적 목적은 매출 증대를 위한 최선의 광고 수단이다.
진정한 전사적 헌신이 없는 사회적 목적은 단기 효과뿐인 목적 세탁이다.
브랜드 차별화는 사회 문제 해결과 무관하다.
친환경 활동은 언제나 기업의 평판을 높인다.
직원 만족은 브랜드 평판보다 항상 우선한다.
gist.explanation_ko: 전사적 헌신이 없는 사회적 목적은 목적 세탁에 불과하여 단기 차별화만 얻고 미래 시장 위치를 잃는다는 것이 요지. ②.
gist.distractor_ko: ①광고 수단, ③무관함, ④항상 평판 상승, ⑤직원 우선은 요지가 아니다.

passage: Eager to stand out, some brands announce a social purpose before doing real good.
Their marketers treat the purpose as a reputation booster, not a true value.
Yet genuine impact demands an authentic, company-wide commitment.
Without it, the mission is mere window-dressing — purpose-washing.
The practice echoes green-washing, made mostly for show.
Such brands enjoy a flash of differentiation.
But the advantage soon fades.
They lose future market position and dishearten their own employees.
choices: Purpose-Washing: When Social Good Is Only for Show
How Green Products Took Over the Marketplace
The Fastest Way to Boost a Brand's Reputation
Why Employees Distrust Every Marketing Campaign
Social Purpose: A Guaranteed Path to Higher Profits
title.explanation_ko: 보여주기식 사회적 목적, 즉 '목적 세탁'을 핵심으로 압축한 ①이 제목.
title.distractor_ko: ②친환경 제품 점유, ③평판 향상법, ④직원 불신, ⑤이익 보장은 초점이 아니다.

passage: Some brands shout about social purpose before they have actually done much good.
Their marketers use it to polish reputation rather than to embrace real change.
True impact, though, requires an authentic, company-wide commitment.
Without that, the mission is just window-dressing — what we call purpose-washing.
Like green-washing, the activity exists mainly for publicity.
Such brands gain only a fleeting edge of differentiation.
Then the curtain falls on their advantage.
They lose future market position and even make their staff feel worse.
choices: the brand is decorating its actual stores more attractively
the stated purpose is a surface display with no real substance
the company is investing heavily in social programs
the marketers have abandoned advertising entirely
the brand has solved the social problem completely
implication.explanation_ko: '사명이 그저 진열장 장식'이라는 비유는 표면적 전시일 뿐 실질이 없음을 뜻한다. ②.
implication.distractor_ko: ①매장 장식(문자적), ③대규모 투자, ④광고 포기, ⑤문제 완전 해결은 모두 다르다.

passage: Realising the benefits of differentiation, some brands broadcast their social purpose before doing much good.
Their marketers are using social purpose to boost the brand's reputation rather than embracing the purpose itself.
Making a real difference with social problems is hard enough.
To succeed, it has to follow from an authentic, company-wide commitment to the purpose.
Otherwise the mission is just window-dressing, or what we call purpose-washing.
It is similar to green-washing, where purpose-driven activities serve mainly for publicity.
Purpose-washing brands gain differentiation, but only for a short while.
They lose out on positioning for future markets, and they might even make employees to feel worse.
grammar._grammar_note: ⑤ 'make employees to feel' 가 비문법. 사역동사 make 는 목적격보어로 원형부정사를 취하므로 'make employees feel' 이 옳다.
grammar.explanation_ko: 사역동사 make + 목적어 + 원형부정사 구조이므로 ⑤는 'make employees feel' 이어야 한다. to부정사 'to feel' 은 비문법. ⑤가 정답.
grammar.distractor_ko: ① 분사구문 Realising, ② rather than + 동명사 embracing, ③ 형용사+enough, ④ has to follow 는 모두 옳다.

passage: Realising the benefits of differentiation, some brands broadcast their social purpose before doing much good.
Their marketers use it to boost the brand's reputation rather than embracing the purpose itself.
Making a real difference requires an authentic, company-wide commitment to the purpose.
Otherwise the mission is just window-dressing, what we call purpose-washing.
It is similar to green-washing, where activities serve mainly for publicity.
Purpose-washing brands gain differentiation, but they keep it permanently.
They lose out on positioning for future markets.
They might even make their own employees feel worse about the company.
vocab._vocab_note: ⑤ 'permanently' 가 의도적 오답. 목적 세탁 브랜드의 차별화는 '잠시(for a short while)'만 얻으므로 '영구히(permanently)'는 정반대이다.
vocab.explanation_ko: 목적 세탁 브랜드는 차별화를 '잠시 동안만(for a short while)' 누린다는 맥락이므로 ⑤ 'permanently(영구히)'는 정반대의 표현이다. ⑤가 정답.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①알리다 ②높이다 ③진정한 ④홍보는 문맥상 모두 적절하다.

passage: Sensing the benefits of differentiation, some brands broadcast their social purpose before doing much good.
Their marketers use it to boost reputation rather than embracing the purpose itself.
Making a real difference is hard; to succeed, it must follow from an authentic, company-wide commitment to the purpose.
Otherwise the mission is just window-dressing, or what we call purpose-washing.
It is similar to green-washing, where activities serve mainly for publicity.
Purpose-washing brands gain differentiation, but only for a short while.
They lose out on positioning for future markets.
They might even make their own employees feel worse about working for them.
blank.explanation_ko: 진정한 변화를 이루려면 전사적인 '헌신(commitment)'에서 비롯되어야 하며, 그렇지 않으면 목적 세탁이라 했다.
blank.distractor_ko: ①저항 ③광고 ④무관심 ⑤할인은 'authentic, company-wide ___ to the purpose' 와 어울리지 않는다.

irrelevant.intro: Realising the benefits of differentiation, some brands broadcast their social purpose before they do much actual good.
sentences: Their marketers are using social purpose to boost the brand's reputation rather than embracing the purpose itself.
Making a real difference with social problems is hard, and it must follow from an authentic, company-wide commitment.
Otherwise the mission is just window-dressing, or what we call purpose-washing, similar to green-washing.
Most consumers prefer to shop online during seasonal sales to save time and money.
Such brands gain differentiation only briefly and lose out on positioning for future markets.
irrelevant.explanation_ko: 글은 '진정한 헌신 없는 사회적 목적 = 목적 세탁'의 흐름인데 ④ '소비자가 시즌 세일에 온라인 쇼핑을 선호한다'는 무관하다.
irrelevant.distractor_ko: ①②③⑤는 모두 사회적 목적과 목적 세탁이라는 주제로 연결된다.

order.given: Realising the benefits of differentiation, some brands broadcast their social purpose before they do much actual good. Their marketers are using social purpose to boost the brand's reputation, rather than embracing the purpose itself.

blocks.A: Purpose-washing brands thus gain one of the benefits of social purpose, differentiation, but only for a short while. They lose out on positioning for future markets, and might even make employees feel worse about working for them.
blocks.B: Otherwise the mission is just window-dressing, or what we call 'purpose-washing' — similar to green-washing, where purpose-driven activities serve mainly for publicity purposes.
blocks.C: Making a real difference with social problems is hard enough; to succeed, it has to follow from an authentic, company-wide commitment to the purpose.

order.explanation_ko: 주어진 글이 '평판용으로 쓴다'로 끝나면, (C)가 '진짜 변화는 전사적 헌신에서 와야 한다'고 대비하고, (B)가 'Otherwise(그렇지 않으면) 목적 세탁'으로 잇고, (A)가 그 결과(단기 차별화·미래 손실)로 마무리한다. (C)-(B)-(A).
order.distractor_ko: (B)의 'Otherwise'는 (C)의 조건을 받으므로 먼저 올 수 없고, (A)의 결과 진술은 가장 마지막에 와야 한다.

insert.insert_sentence: Making a real difference with social problems is hard enough; to succeed, it has to follow from an authentic, company-wide commitment to the purpose.

passage_marked.text: Realising the benefits of differentiation, some brands broadcast their social purpose before they do much actual good.
Their marketers are using social purpose to boost the brand's reputation, rather than embracing the purpose itself.
Otherwise the mission is just window-dressing, or what we call 'purpose-washing' — similar to green-washing.
Purpose-washing brands gain differentiation, but only for a short while.
They lose out on positioning for future markets, and might even make employees feel worse about working for them.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장은 '진정한 전사적 헌신이 있어야 한다'는 조건이고, 바로 뒤 ③의 'Otherwise(그렇지 않으면 ... 목적 세탁)'가 이 조건을 받는다. 따라서 ③ 자리(평판용 사용 진술과 Otherwise 사이)에 들어가야 한다. ③이 정답.
insert.distractor_ko: ③에 넣지 않으면 'Otherwise(그렇지 않으면)'가 받을 '진정한 헌신' 조건이 앞에 없어 글이 끊긴다.

passage: Some brands announce a social purpose before doing real good.
Marketers use it to boost reputation, not to embrace genuine change.
Real impact requires an authentic, company-wide commitment.
Without that, the mission is mere window-dressing — purpose-washing.
Like green-washing, it exists mainly for publicity.
Such brands win only brief differentiation.
They lose position in future markets.
They may even make their own employees feel worse.
summary.summary_template: Unless a brand's social purpose rests on a genuine __(A)__ commitment, it is mere purpose-washing that yields only __(B)__ advantage.
summary.explanation_ko: 진정한 (A)전사적(company-wide) 헌신이 없으면 목적 세탁에 불과하여 (B)단기(short-term) 이점만 얻는다. ②.
summary.distractor_ko: (A)는 personal/temporary 가 아니라 company-wide, (B)는 lasting/financial 이 아니라 short-term 이어야 한다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그렇지 않으면 그 사명은 그저 보여주기식에 불과하다.
writing.answer: Otherwise the mission is just window-dressing.
writing.explanation_ko: Otherwise(그렇지 않으면) + 주어 the mission + is just window-dressing(그저 보여주기식).

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 그들의 마케터들은 사회적 목적 그 자체를 받아들이기보다 브랜드의 평판을 높이기 위해 그것을 사용한다.
writing.answer: Their marketers use it to boost the brand's reputation rather than embracing the purpose itself.
writing.explanation_ko: to부정사 to boost + 비교 rather than + 동명사 embracing, 강조 the purpose itself.

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 성공하려면, 그것은 그 목적에 대한 진정하고 전사적인 헌신에서 비롯되어야 한다.
conditions: has to follow from 을 사용할 것
writing.answer: To succeed, it has to follow from an authentic, company-wide commitment to the purpose.
writing.explanation_ko: To succeed(성공하려면) + has to follow from(~에서 비롯되어야 한다) + authentic, company-wide commitment.

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 흐름상 빈칸에 들어갈 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.context: A brand that promotes social purpose only for publicity, without real action, is engaged in what the writer calls ___________.
writing.explanation_ko: 실질 없는 홍보용 사회적 목적을 본문은 'purpose-washing(목적 세탁)'이라 부른다.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: Purpose-washing brands gain one of the benefits of social purpose, differentiation, but only for a short while.
writing.answer: 목적 세탁을 하는 브랜드들은 사회적 목적의 이점 중 하나인 차별화를 얻지만, 오직 잠시 동안만 그러하다.
writing.explanation_ko: one of the benefits(이점 중 하나), differentiation(차별화), but only for a short while(그러나 오직 잠시 동안만).
